question: When are CTSA UM1 applications due?
expected: There are multiple receipt dates (same for new and renewal/resubmission): March 13, 2025; May 28, 2025; September 29, 2025; January 28, 2026; May 28, 2026; September 28, 2026; January 28, 2027; May 28, 2027; and September 28, 2027, all by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization. The NOFO expires September 29, 2027.

question: What's the most we can ask for per year?
expected: The maximum direct cost request depends on the hub's budget tier (based on 5-year average NIH direct cost funding of the applicant plus partners), with tiers ranging from $2,600,000 to $6,500,000 in direct costs per year; the project period is up to 7 years.
